questions.question: To which creature does Proverbs 6 send the sluggard to learn?
How many things does the LORD hate, according to Proverbs 6?
options: Six, even seven that are an abomination
Ten, the number of the commandments
Five, one for each book of the law
Three, even four that he despises
questions.answer: Six, even seven that are an abomination

questions.question: Proverbs 6 lists a lying tongue and hands that shed innocent blood among the things the LORD hates.
Go to the ant, O sluggard; consider her ways, and be _____.
There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are an abomination to _____.
